Compare every TEI page, source paragraph, line, word count, order, source-derived group, page label, original-image relationship and PDF facsimile target to retained carriers.
Check preliminaries/contents/Part I divider, both part boundaries, back-matter boundaries, and two source-visible heading positions.
Compare all 89 Abbyy table blocks, including every row, cell, and OCR line, with separate alternate TEI table witnesses.
Confirm nonaccepted status, unresolved OCR and semantic gaps, TEI P5 validity, and candidate-package schema.

limitations: Uncorrected OCR has severe Greek recognition errors.
Eleven access pages have no OCR word tokens; image-only text remains untranscribed.
Paradigms are retained as alternate Abbyy OCR tables, but Greek cell readings and their attachment to DjVu paragraphs are not print-verified; vocabulary and index entries retain source line carriers.
The contents page-level hierarchy is preserved, but four-page entry and column alignment cannot be reliably recovered from DjVu OCR.
Full image-to-TEI collation and human acceptance remain open.
